brand: Glory By Us is a hair brand built around culture and community, with a focus on healthy ingredients.
Glory By Us describes itself as healthy hair care for curls, waves and beards.
Glory Pomade Paste works for waves, curls, beards, slick-backs and buns.
The Glory durag is Glory's own branded durag, made and sold by Glory. It is not customisable.
Glory's taglines are 'Indulge in the Process.' and 'Our Hair Matters'.
The Glory Family is what Glory calls its community.

products.name: Pomade Paste
page_lines: Hold Different Forget the greasy pomades that weigh you down.
This is a whipped, spongy paste that melts on contact and moves with you — through the beard, through the curl pattern, through the wave check.
Built with raw botanicals, it locks your style down with commanding hold while it works the scalp underneath, because looking clean is a lifestyle, not a look.
The Feel: Light, whipped, spongy — melts into an invisible hold with a clean, natural finish.
No grease, no cake, no cap.
The Routine: Warm a dime-sized amount between your palms to wake up the botanicals.
Run it through your beard, curls, or waves — fresh cut or deep wave phase, whatever stage you're in — and lock it in.
The Botanical Work Avocado Oil — fatty acids, potassium, magnesium.
Penetrates deep, builds texture, leaves a natural shine that reads clean under any light.
Scalp health is the foundation everything else stands on.
Shea Butter & Aloe Vera Base — moisture without the weight.
No clogged pores, no flakes, just slip.

Why It Wins All-day hold, zero weight Lays every stray hair down on command Feeds the scalp while it styles Works instantly, washes out clean Built for beards, curls, and waves — fresh cuts to deep wolfing phases Clean ingredients, no shortcuts

products.name: Hydrating Peppermint Conditioner
page_lines: Indulge in the spark.
This ultra-rich, decadent conditioner is engineered with a thick, commanding consistency that grips every strand and clings beautifully to hair and beard.
It provides an effortless, silky slip that detangles and deeply hydrates, leaving your pattern perfectly defined and your stride completely softened.
The Sensation: A dense, velvety cream that delivers an immediate, cooling electricity to the scalp.
The Ritual: After cleansing, smooth a generous amount through damp hair, beard, and scalp.
Massage mindfully to activate the cooling spark.
Let the botanical alchemy absorb for a few minutes, then rinse to reveal unparalleled strength and luster.
The Botanical Alchemy Peppermint & Menthol: The cooling tingle you feel the moment it hits your scalp.
It wakes the scalp up and leaves it feeling fresh.
Artichoke Leaf Extract: Rich in potent antioxidants to actively shield the hair, scalp, and skin from environmental stress, preserving youthfulness and longevity.

products.name: Brush (Your Hair)
page_lines: Indulge in the process.
This isn’t just a tool; it is the definitive rhythm of your routine.
Sculpted with a sleek, curved surface that mirrors the natural contours of your head and face, this brush epitomizes Glory’s ethos: it’s more than a product—it’s a discipline.
The Sensation: A firm yet forgiving stroke that grips the hair without pulling, delivering a soothing, therapeutic massage to the scalp.
The Ritual: For waves, use long, deliberate strokes from the crown outward to lock in your pattern.
For fresh cuts, let the soft-medium bristles glide gently to enhance definition.
For wolfing or beard grooming, use steady pressure to lay every single strand without lifting.

The Architecture of the Process 100% Pure Boar Bristles: Cultivated to naturally mimic your hair’s texture, distributing your scalp’s natural oils evenly from root to tip for an undeniable, high-end luster.
The Soft/Medium Calibration: The perfect structural sweet spot.
Gentle enough to respect a fresh, sharp fade, yet resilient enough to lay down bulk hair during a deep wolfing phase.
Contoured Curved Geometry: Engineered to maximize contact with every stroke, covering more surface area of the scalp, waves, and jawline with absolute precision.

products.name: Glory Double-sided Checkered Durag
page_lines: Indulge in the preservation.
The definitive final step of your ritual.
The Glory Signature Durag is crafted with an uncompromising dedication to form, function, and luxury.
Designed to seamlessly lock in moisture and protect your waves, curls, and scalp, this is more than an accessory—it is the guardian of your process.

Engineered with a double-sided print, it offers a reversible, versatile aesthetic, allowing you to shift your style while maintaining a flawless compress that lets you soften your stride with absolute confidence.
The Sensation: A weightless, silk-like glide against the skin and hair, offering the perfect balance of breathability and compression.
The Ritual: After applying your Glory Pomade Paste or Hydrating Conditioner, lay your pattern with your Sculpting Brush.
Secure the durag smoothly over your crown, tying the wide, flat bands without tension to lock in the moisture and protect your waves through the night or throughout the day.
The Architecture of Preservation Intricate Double-Sided Aesthetic: Featuring premium, high-definition double-sided printing, this durag offers two distinct, elevated looks in one.
Seamlessly transition your style to match your mood, without ever sacrificing protection.
This durag is built to withstand the rigors of daily wear and wash cycles without fraying.
Optimal Compression & Slip: Calibrated with wide, long straps that distribute pressure evenly across the forehead and temples.
It delivers the perfect tension needed to lay down your hair during deep wolfing phases, while protecting the scalp from friction.

products.name: Rosemary Myrrh Shampoo & Body Bar

It melts upon contact into a dense, velvety lather that provides maximum slip—perfect for brushing through waves, defining curls, and clarifying skin.
Fueled by invigorating rosemary and sacred myrrh, it purifies without stripping, leaving your scalp stimulated, your pattern locked, and your stride softened.

Glide across the skin to cleanse and balance, then rinse thoroughly.
